string.text: Take the helmet off when using an eatable item with a helmet on, then consume the item. See the options below for the modifier key and re-equipping.
If enabled, the helmet is only taken off when the modifier key is held while using the item. If disabled, it is taken off every time you use an eatable item with a helmet on.
The key that must be held while using a consumable (quick slot or inventory) when 'Require modifier key' is enabled.
Put the helmet back on after the item has been consumed. If disabled, the helmet stays off.
